key_insight: MOTIF improves out-of-distribution materials property prediction by using LLMs to propose chemical taxonomies rather than predict numerical properties directly.
engineering_relevance: The framework can improve prediction robustness when screening materials with chemistries beyond the training distribution.
method: Generate candidate material taxonomies with LLMs.
Retain taxonomies that improve training-only pseudo-OOD validation.
Select invariant features within each accepted taxonomy and combine predictions through gated aggregation.
evidence_signal: On 2D halide perovskites, mean OOD bandgap MAE fell from 0.122 to 0.111 eV; frozen dev/test evaluation also showed gains, with transfer assessed on 3D perovskite solar cell efficiencies and structure-split Matbench tasks.
watch_item: Taxonomy selection must remain training-only to prevent leakage, and pseudo-OOD validation may not represent future chemistry shifts.
paper_title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
